notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA lists and the Unknown/Undocumented table (from Thornton's book) are the only sources for the tower itself. Forest Lookouts lists a Jakey's Point in El Dorado County; the name is close and it may be the same site, but this is unconfirmed, so the story says so and the record has no other_names entry. Two searches found no history for Jakeys Hill (results were Jakes Peak in Desolation Wilderness and unrelated Jersey Hill pages). Story body is about 110 words; the Forest Lookouts paragraph carries the only new fact, and the story was not padded. Fact-check 2026-10-10: the first sentence of that paragraph lacked a footnote and was given one. Record fields agree with the FFLA row (county, coordinates, Gone). Worth trying: Eldorado NF office or lookout inventory, Thornton's book, and whether Forest Lookouts' Jakey's Point is the same site.
